card.name: Inside phenyl and ethylene chemical names
card.fires_on: The partway point inside chemical names such as phenylalanine, phenylacetate and trichloroethylene, just before an eth/gly-type piece (ethyl, ethylene, glycol, glutamine). Also fires on a few linking marks after ethylene glycol or a vehicle name.
